scope: Independent source-referenced visual review of the explicitly authorized upper-perch paper-ribbon correction; no candidate edits by this reviewer. Full frame1600 also inspected for regression.

observations.native_alpha: Compared the original source region with a dark composite at native source resolution, and inspected removed-alpha overlays. Only a very narrow source-paper allowance remains at fine boundary pixels; no broad ribbon or disconnected paper fragment remains in the target area.
observations.renderer: Current stock frame1600 and its native-pixel perch crop show the paper ribbon resolved. The branch rises naturally into the gripping foot without a pale diagonal strip. Full-bird head, bill, feather fringe, wing, tail and pose remain unchanged visually.
observations.geometry: 1145 by 1115 final cut and normalized whole-bird box are unchanged from the previously source-referenced geometry; projecting perch is not used as the bird bound.

remaining_limitations: Historical paper grain and pigment texture remain intentionally. Assessment is software visual review; no physical panel certification.
